function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the current temperature in Moscow right now.  
You can quickly check the latest weather (in Celsius) by visiting a weather website such as:

* [weather.com](https://weather.com/)
* [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com/)
* [OpenWeatherMap](https://openweathermap.org/)

Just type “Moscow” into the search bar and you’ll see the current temperature, forecast, and other details.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What wheather is now in Moscow, in celsius?" They want current weather in Moscow in Celsius. We need to provide the current temperature. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we cannot fetch real-time data. We can suggest using a weather API or website. We can also provide a placeholder or approximate. But we should be honest. So answer: I can't fetch real-time data. Suggest checking a weather service.
